about.title: About CAP Roofing and Construction
text: CAP Roofing and Construction LLC is a locally owned company proudly serving Houston and surrounding areas with professionalism and integrity.

We specialize in navigating insurance claims, ensuring a smooth process from start to finish. Our team delivers high-quality roofing services—expert inspections, reliable repairs, and top-tier roof replacements—at competitive prices.
When storms hit, we’re here to protect your home. In addition to roofing, we offer professional fencing solutions and mitigation services to enhance your property’s value and safety.
